Theorem
[Uniqueness of asymptotic cones (Theorem 27.51)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0050 1. ch27:27.51\group Shrinker geometry at infinity

Two complete noncompact shrinkers with two ends asymptotic to the same smooth Euclidean cone have isometric universal covers.
